name: Khatta meetha poha
ingredients_raw: Rice flakes (64%), Sugar, Interesterified Vegetable fat (Palm oil and Palm kernel oil), Raisins, Peanuts, Salt, Dehydrated Onion flakes, Green chilli, Curry leaves, Dry mango powder, Maltodextrin, Turmeric, Cumin, Mustard, Acidity regulators [Citric acid (E330) & Tartaric acid (E334)], Natural lemon flavour.
